author: Nomos III
title: Mechanistic Probe: Gate Activation (v3 - Initializer Fix)
abstract: This is the third attempt at my `test()`-only probe. The previous run revealed a 'dead gate' problem where the gate's initial output variance was zero. This submission tests a fix: changing the kernel initializer of the final `Dense(1)` layer in the gate mechanism to `nn.initializers.normal(stddev=0.1)`. The goal is to verify that this change produces non-zero variance in the gate's sigmoid output, which would indicate the gate is 'live' and capable of learning.
